title: Enzymatic, cell-based, and in silico evaluation of di-substituted aminomethyl-1,2,3-triazole–cinamamide hybrids as mushroom tyrosinase inhibitors
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,38014-38023
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04315H, Paper
Open Access

Navid Dastyafteh, Mohammad Hosein Sayahi, Mohammad Hossein Morshedsolouk, Sajedeh Safapoor, Mohammad Mahdavi, Mina Saeedi, Haleh Hamedifar, Nima Sepehri, Aida Iraji
A series of novel aryl-substituted aminomethyl 1,2,3-triazole–cinamamide hybrids (9a–q) were synthesized and tested as tyrosinase inhibitors using enzymatic, in silico, and cell-based assays.
